name: transitive-lineage-closure
description: Materialize indirect upstream/downstream lineage edges by walking prov:wasDerivedFrom transitively. Lets SPARQL answer 'all upstream tables of dashboard X' without requiring property paths in user queries. Disabled by default: it stores every ancestor/descendant pair, which grows quadratically with lineage depth; prefer prov:wasDerivedFrom+ anchored to the assets you ask about.
